# DreamAvatar Ability Text

Components · Live demo & interactive props: `/cumulus#/dream-avatar-ability-text`

Real consumers: **2** (imports outside `src/cumulus/docs/` and tests).

The complete DreamAvatar rules-text source: hovering, focusing, or touch-holding anywhere in the ability reveals one compact title-free card containing every defined term in glossary-priority order, using DreamAvatar-specific exhaust guidance.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dreamAvatarId` | `string` | yes | — | Stable DreamAvatar UUID that owns this ability. |
| `text` | `string` | yes | — | Complete rendered rules text for the DreamAvatar ability. |
| `presentation` | `"natural" \| "selectionCard"` | no | `natural` | Natural copy for flowing layouts, or the two-line aligned selection-card treatment used by the desktop DreamAvatar offer triptych. |

## Usage

Pass the DreamAvatar UUID and complete rendered rules text. The stationary source keeps the default text cursor and explains exhaust as a once-per-turn DreamAvatar ability. Use the selection-card presentation for the aligned desktop offer triptych.

```tsx
import { DreamAvatarAbilityText } from "src/cumulus/components/hud/DreamAvatarAbilityText";

<DreamAvatarAbilityText
  dreamAvatarId={dreamAvatar.id}
  text={dreamAvatar.renderedText}
  presentation="selectionCard"
/>
```
